name: data_localization_tool
description: Data tool for localizing pages and components into secondary locales. Read and update static page content, component content, and component property overrides for any non-primary locale. Writes target secondary locales only — the primary (default) locale cannot be edited through this tool. Also includes list_components for discovering component IDs to localize.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

get_component_content.description: Read component content (text, images, nested components) for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it to read the primary locale's content.

anyOf.description: Run get_component_content: Read component content (text, images, nested components) for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it to read the primary locale's content.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

get_component_properties.description: Read component property definitions and current values for a given locale. Pass localeId to read overrides for a secondary locale.

anyOf.description: Run get_component_properties: Read component property definitions and current values for a given locale. Pass localeId to read overrides for a secondary locale.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

get_page_content.description: Read a page's content structure for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale.

anyOf.description: Run get_page_content: Read a page's content structure for a given locale. Pass localeId to read a secondary locale; omit it for the primary locale.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be returned (max limit: 100)

offset.description: Offset used for pagination if the results have more than limit records.

list_components.description: List all components in a site. Returns component metadata including IDs, names, and versions.

anyOf.description: Run list_components: List all components in a site. Returns component metadata including IDs, names, and versions.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: HTML content of the node, including the HTML tag.
Value used to override a component property.

propertyOverrides.description: Properties to override for this locale's component instances.

anyOf.description: Update text property overrides of a component instance.

nodes.description: Array of node updates. Each item is either: (1) a text node { nodeId, text } where text is the HTML content including the wrapping tag, or (2) a property override { nodeId, propertyOverrides: [{ propertyId, text }] } for component instances. Obtain nodeIds from get_component_content.

update_component_content.description: Localize a component into a secondary locale by overriding text nodes and property values. Requires localeId — this action only writes to secondary locales. The primary (default) locale cannot be edited through this action.

anyOf.description: Run update_component_content: Localize a component into a secondary locale by overriding text nodes and property values. Requires localeId — this action only writes to secondary locales. The primary (default) locale cannot be edited through this action.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: New value for the property in this locale.

properties.description: Array of properties to update for this component.

update_component_properties.description: Localize component property values into a secondary locale. Requires localeId — only secondary locales can be edited. The primary locale's property values are not editable through this action.

anyOf.description: Run update_component_properties: Localize component property values into a secondary locale. Requires localeId — only secondary locales can be edited. The primary locale's property values are not editable through this action.

localeId.description: Unique identifier for a specific locale. Applicable when using localization.

text.description: HTML content of the node, including the HTML tag. The HTML tags must be the same as what’s returned from the Get Content endpoint.
Value used to override a component property; must be type-compatible to prevent errors.

items.description: Properties to override for this locale’s component instances.

anyOf.description: Update text property overrides of a component instance.

nodes.description: Array of node updates. Each item is either: (1) a text node { nodeId, text } where text is the full HTML content including the wrapping tag, or (2) a property override { nodeId, propertyOverrides: [{ propertyId, text }] } for component instances. Obtain nodeIds from get_page_content.

update_static_content.description: Localize a static page into a secondary locale by overriding its text nodes and property values. Requires localeId — only secondary locales can be edited. The primary locale's static content cannot be updated through this action.

anyOf.description: Run update_static_content: Localize a static page into a secondary locale by overriding its text nodes and property values. Requires localeId — only secondary locales can be edited. The primary locale's static content cannot be updated through this action.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property: get_component_content, get_component_properties, get_page_content, list_components, update_component_content, update_component_properties, update_static_content.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
